acceptanceCriteria: A forged-history test on main shows whether over-capacity pinned guidance is refused in receipt audit and redo.
If it is not refused, the bound is ported onto EscalationReceiptAudit with that regression; otherwise the ticket closes with the test as evidence.
body: Issue 502 was delivered twice from base d524530f: on main by #610 and #612 (kept), and by the lane claude/v1-0699-escalations-rest (head 2d16ae3b, reverted from the batch branch claude/batch-2026-10-05b because it duplicated main). The lane round 7 commit 31118365 added an audit-time check that the aggregate answer guidance an admitted claim pins stays within 256 KiB (EscalationMaxGuidanceBytes in wire/ticketkeys.go, journal/escalation_audit.go, regression in store/escalation_audit_test.go), so a forged history cannot exceed what the writer would admit. Main enforces guidance capacity at claim time (TestIssue502_ImmutableClaimAnswerSelection) and adds transaction.EscalationReceiptAudit. Question: does main receipt audit and redo refuse a forged history whose pinned guidance exceeds the claim-time bound? If not, port the check onto main fold with a forged-history regression.
title: Escalations: does receipt audit bound the aggregate claim guidance capacity over forged history? (superseded lane 31118365)
